text:
Nina (new-hire): Hey everyone — first week today! Quick question: where do I find the product handbook and the team docs in Notion? I tried searching for 'eng onboarding' and templates but a few pages look view-only. Who should I ask for edit access? Thanks!

Aisha (People Ops): Welcome Nina :wave: Handbook is under Notion > Company Home > Handbooks > Product + Eng. For edit access we usually add folks to the 'Engineering Editors' group. If you DM me your work email I can kick off the invite, or just reply here with it.

mike_eng: Hi Nina — also check the Eng space (left sidebar) > Onboarding > Eng Onboarding Checklist. The checklist links to the common templates (RFC, Postmortem, Runbook). RFC template is called "RFC Template v3". If a page is view-only it's probably in the Team Restricted section.

lexi_docs: Echoing above — you can click "Request access" on any page and that auto-creates a docs-requests ticket. If you tag me (@lexi_docs) in the access request I can pre-approve faster. For moving/creating top-level pages we prefer using the templates in /Templates > Team Templates so structure stays consistent.

andreadev: FYI some infra/playbook pages are restricted to SRE + Infra teams. If you need temporary edit on Serving Runtime Playbook ping me + Aisha and include why you need it and the duration.

Nina (new-hire): Thanks — my work email is nina@redwood.com. I mostly need edit access to add a few onboarding links to my personal ramp doc and to copy the RFC template.

Aisha (People Ops): Got it — adding you to Engineering Editors now. Should see invite in Notion in a few minutes.

devex-bot: docs-requests — New access ticket created (#DR-4821) for nina@redwood.com, requested by Aisha. Link: https://notion.company/requests/DR-4821

lexi_docs: I'll pre-approve the RFC template copy once your request ticket is visible. Welcome again! :tada:

Nina (new-hire): Awesome, thank you all! One more small Q — is there a preferred filename convention for personal ramp notes so others can find them later?

mike_eng: We generally use "first-last (team) - ramp" or "first-last - onboarding". For team-shared ramp docs put them under Eng > Ramps and add a short description at the top.

Aisha (People Ops): Confirmed — added to Eng Editors and sent welcome checklist DM. If you hit any blocked pages ping this thread or @Aisha.

devex-bot: docs-requests — Access granted to nina@redwood.com for "Engineering Editors" (group). Ticket DR-4821 closed.
